planned_math_to_code.statement: R(B)=tr C_tt-2 tr(B C_at)+tr(B C_aa B^T).
R(0)-R(B*)=tr(C_ta C_aa^-1 C_at)>=0 under the stipulated true moments.
For fitted B=B*+E, centered excess risk is tr(E C_aa E^T).
Using fitted means adds squared bias ||mu_t-muhat_t+B(muhat_a-mu_a)||^2 to centered risk.
For centered law P(e=0,r=+/-1)=9/20 each and P(e=+/-10,r=+/-5)=1/20 each, C_aa=17/5,C_ta=5,B*=25/17. Squared risk falls 10 -> 45/17 while E|e-Br| rises 1 -> 27/17.

planned_math_to_code.statement: Away from zero residuals, the unpenalized centered unsquared stationarity equation is E[(e-Br)r^T/||e-Br||]=0. At zero use a norm subgradient with magnitude <=1.
L_tau(Theta)=sum_i w_i sqrt(||E_i-Theta phi_i||^2+tau^2)+(lambda/2)||B||_F^2; output F_t-b_t-B_t r0 with exact native anchor override.
For s,s_k>=0, sqrt(s+tau^2)<=sqrt(s_k+tau^2)+(s-s_k)/(2sqrt(s_k+tau^2)), with equality at s=s_k.
Let q_i=w_i/sqrt(||E_i-Theta_k phi_i||^2+tau^2), H=sum_i q_i phi_i phi_i^T+lambda diag(0,I), K=sum_i q_i E_i phi_i^T. Then Theta_(k+1)=K H^-1.
H is positive definite for positive total q and lambda>0 even if all r0_i lie in a singular subspace.

An exact unconstrained surrogate solve implies L_tau(Theta_(k+1))<=Q(Theta_(k+1)|Theta_k)<=Q(Theta_k|Theta_k)=L_tau(Theta_k). Also 0<=L_tau(Theta)-L_0(Theta)<=tau sum_i w_i for the same slope penalty.
Neither the quadratic identity nor smoothed development descent establishes lower native CD3D, CD4D or CD-M.
